title: Coercivity, collision support, and the identity braid for the class (1,0,-1)
exact_target: Find collision-free three-body periodic orbits in winding class (1,0,−1), assess their minimization, and realize the trivial braid.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002536 (AIM-PHYSICS-0044). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Variational Methods in Celestial Mechanics; notes by Kuo-Chang Chen, version 22 June 2003, source item 7.

status_qualification: Winding and braid constraints are kept distinct. The source does not impose additional symmetry constraints or mass ratios for these questions. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
